items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: But he composed a song at my house, and I've forgotten it.

ctx.x: And Buddy Christian had some, too.
Yeah, he composed a... I forgot the name of... But he composed a song at my house, and I've forgotten it. He played since I was talking to you.
He used to... I heard that.
